pairs.beforeAlt: Before: Weber Genesis II 3-burner gas grill mid-service in a West Chester backyard — grates removed, heat shields and burner area exposed with carbonized buildup
pairs.afterAlt: After: same Weber Genesis II 3-burner with clean grates reinstalled, a polished cookbox interior, and a clear control panel

pairs.beforeAlt: Before: Weber 4-burner gas grill with Sear Station in a Cincinnati backyard, grates and cookbox caked with carbon and grease buildup
pairs.afterAlt: After: same Weber 4-burner gas grill with clean grates, a polished cookbox, and a clear Sear Station after service

pairs.beforeAlt: Before: 5-burner built-in grill at a stone island with carbonized buildup on the grates and grease on the cookbox
pairs.afterAlt: After: same 5-burner built-in grill with a clean polished cookbox and restored grates

pairs.beforeAlt: Before: 5-burner gas grill on a back patio with grease and soot across the cookbox and grates
pairs.afterAlt: After: same 5-burner gas grill with a clean cookbox interior and fresh grates

pairs.beforeAlt: Before: DCS 5-burner built-in with blackened soot on the hood and heavy carbon buildup across the grates
pairs.afterAlt: After: same DCS 5-burner built-in with a clean stainless hood and polished cookbox

jobs.notes: Hood interior was nearly impossible to see through. Four hours of teardown and degreasing brought it back to factory.
